control_failures.control_label: application of positive isolation devices and personal locks
authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.title: unplanned release of electrical energy at G-8101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus on G-8101 and TT-8101 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. G-8101 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 27 August 2022 a high potential incident was recorded on G-8101 and TT-8101 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during a statutory inspection; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
